desc: Implement reverse + two-pointer + monotonic deque `(value, count)` approach computing cost = sum_suffix_max - sum_window, shrinking left while cost > k, summing `right - left + 1`; verified examples give 17 and 12.
Test edge cases: n=1, strictly increasing, strictly decreasing, all equal, k=1e9, and large n for O(n) performance.
Integrated into the provided `Solution` class method signature as a single self-contained function.
Verified alternative approaches (two-stack aggregate, segment-tree-over-left-endpoints) unnecessary since deque solution is correct and O(n).
